adminReach.title: What reaches me

mine.label: Only my work
mine.hint: You see only the chats and the notices of your own projects and to-dos. A message that names you still reaches you.

mixed.label: My work, and the rest in the list
mixed.hint: The other project chats stay in your list. They count only the messages that name you.

all.label: Everything
all.hint: Every message of every project chat counts. The bell gets a copy of each notice of the office. A copy sends no push and no email.

adminReach.copyGone: A change that you can no longer see

copy.stage_changed: {{actor}} changed the stage of {{target}} and told {{people}}
copy.meeting_cancelled: {{actor}} cancelled {{target}}, which was planned for {{day}} at {{time}}, and told {{people}}
copy.helper_joined: {{actor}} joined “{{target}}” as a helper and told {{people}}
copy.reply_task: {{actor}} replied to {{people}} in a comment on “{{target}}”

2026-10-23-69.title: Choose what reaches you
2026-10-23-69.body: As the Admin, you can now choose what reaches you. Pick “Only my work”, “My work, and the rest in the list”, or “Everything”. With Everything, you see every project chat message in the count, and the bell shows a copy of each notice of the office. You find the choice in Settings.
